bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 109; docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const fs=require("fs");(async()=>{const token=fs.readFileSync(process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE,"utf8").trim();const api=async(method,arg)=>{const res=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/"+method,{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(arg),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000)});const j=await res.json();if(!j.ok)throw Error("api_failure");return j.result};const me=await api("getMe",{});if(me.username!=="GayBBS_bot")process.exit(110);let code=80;for(const [id,bit] of [[-1003847210571,1],[-1002373696859,2],[-1003770334893,4]]){try{const chat=await api("getChat",{chat_id:id});const member=await api("getChatMember",{chat_id:id,user_id:me.id});if(chat.type!=="supergroup"||!["administrator","creator"].includes(member.status))code+=bit;}catch{code+=bit;}}process.exit(code)})().catch(()=>process.exit(111))' >/dev/null 2>&1
